core_obligations: Convert formal unramifiedness to unramifiedness using local finite presentation.
Exhibit the conormal sheaf as a direct summand of a finite locally free one.
difficulty_reason: For an lci morphism of schemes f : X -> Y, unramified is equivalent to formally unramified (formally unramified + lci's local finite presentation by the in-source unramified-formally-unramified lemma), and in this case C_{X/Y} is finite locally free: factor f locally as X -> V Koszul-regular then V -> Y smooth; the two-unramified-morphisms-formally-smooth lemma identifies C_{X/Y} as a locally direct summand of C_{X/V}, finite locally free since a Koszul-regular (quasi-regular) immersion has finite locally free conormal (Divisors, quasi-regular-immersion). Retained author proof at lines 18716-18728.
